{{Quote|The choices of one shape the futures of all.|A line from the ''Song of Salaban'' describing Salaban's story|<ref name="COC" />}}
'''Salaban''' was an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] featured in the ''[[Song of Salaban]]'', an Arkanian legend. According to the legend, they lost everything after making the wrong choices.<ref name="COC" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] compared Salaban's story to that of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sorro]], who served the warlord after losing his [[Sorro's family|family]]. The pair made use of a [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] named ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="COC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salaban was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="COC" />
